name: Swaran Ghar
description: An unspoken sacrifice, a nearly perfect family and a shocking betrayal! Swaran gave up her love to build a beautiful family, but little did she know that her kids would one day abandon her when she needed them the most. Will greed take over the matters of the heart? Will a mother's power shake the core of her sons' lives?

credits_cast.character: Swaran Kanwaljeet Bedi / Swaran Ajeet Lamba Chandni
credits_cast.name: Sangita Ghosh

videos.title: Meet Kanwaljeet and Swaran
videos.overview: Kanwaljeet Bedi and his wife, Swaran's lives revolve around their sons, Nakul, Vikram and Yug. While Swaran and Kanwaljeet pine for their children's attention, will these ideal parents get the respect they deserve?
